speaker: Doctor
text: Dr. Agent: I need to understand the specifics of your skin lesion. How long has it been present, and have you noticed any changes in its size, color, or shape recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Penis and Digit (with high suspicion for lymphoma given the bilateral presentation and smoking history). REQUEST IMAGES: [Penile and finger lesion close-ups showing ulceration, induration, and borders].
